resources.title: Cloud Engineer: The Cloud Foundation — Core Concepts, Platforms, and Modern Infrastructure Infographic (1 of 4)
resources.description: What a Cloud Engineer actually does: building, deploying, and managing cloud infrastructure, automating deployment with IaC/DevOps, monitoring performance/cost/reliability. Covers the three major cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) and their core services, core skills (virtualization, containers/Docker, orchestration/Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, identity & security, monitoring), the learning stack of courses, real-world labs (multi-cloud environment, containerized app deployment, Terraform/Bicep automation), key concepts you'll master, and the career path from Cloud Engineer through Cloud Architect with real salary ranges.

resources.title: Cloud Engineer: Cloud Security, Identity, Networking, and High Availability Infographic (2 of 4)
resources.description: The reliability and security layer of cloud engineering: cloud security & compliance (encryption, WAF, NSG, threat monitoring, NIST/CIS/ISO 27001), identity & access management (least privilege, Microsoft Entra ID, AWS IAM, Google Cloud IAM, MFA, conditional access), cloud networking (VNet/VPC design, subnets, routing, load balancers, firewalls), high availability & resiliency (redundancy, Availability Zones/Regions, auto-scaling, fault tolerance), disaster recovery (backup/snapshot/replication strategies, RPO/RTO testing), and monitoring & operations (Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, GCP Operations), with a realistic 4-week secure-and-scale roadmap.

resources.title: Cloud Engineer: Infrastructure as Code, Automation, and Real-World Operations Infographic (3 of 4)
resources.description: The operational engineering layer: infrastructure as code (Terraform and Bicep, version-controlled repeatable environments), automation & CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab, Jenkins pipelines), containers & orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, images/registries/clusters/scaling), observability & operations (Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, GCP Operations, SRE basics), cost management & optimization (Azure Cost Management, AWS Cost Explorer, right-sizing, reserved/savings plans), security & governance (Zero Trust, IAM policies, tagging, encryption), hands-on labs across all three clouds, and a 4-week build/automate/operate roadmap.

resources.title: Cloud Engineer: Capstone, Certification, Job Readiness, and a Long-Term Cloud Career Infographic (4 of 4)
resources.description: Turning cloud engineering skills into a real job: the capstone project (design and deploy a multi-cloud solution with IaC, containers, monitoring, security, and cost optimization), recommended industry certifications (Microsoft Azure Administrator AZ-104, AWS Solutions Architect Associate, Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer), interview prep and real scenario-based questions, building a professional GitHub portfolio with architecture diagrams and IaC code, a 5-step job search roadmap, career growth and salary ranges from Cloud Engineer through Cloud Architect, the full tools & services recap, and a practical 90-day action plan.
